critical_code_review_comments: security_checkpoint.py is now 1201 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting (subject resolution, decision, visitor-log/lookup/batch) into sub-modules for maintainability.
Public POST /api/security/checkpoint/pair, /scan, /lookup, /check-in-batch all rely on the device session header — confirmed unauth returns 401 and short query returns 400.
check_in_only branch correctly bypasses location restriction and confirms via 'no access restriction' / 'check-in only' reason text.
Entry/exit pairing using find_one_and_update with sort (instead of motor's plain update_one) correctly sets exit_at + exit_event_id on the entry row — verified end-to-end via /visitor-log.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration141_security_unification.py (created — 18 tests, 16 pass + 2 skipped pre-fix → fixed to 18 pass)
seed_data_creation: Each test creates and cleans up its own checkpoints + members. Event-ticket tests create a TEST_Iter141_Event_* event and one public booking via /api/public/bookings/event then delete the checkpoint (event/booking not cleaned — minor, prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest baseline is now 57/57 (test_iteration91_security_checkpoint.py + test_smoke_recent_modules.py + test_iteration141_security_unification.py). Two early skips were due to public booking payload using the wrong field name (`guests` vs `num_tickets`) — fixed in-test. The scan resolver only resolves member-by-ID when scan_type='qr' (or member-card/badge); 'manual' scan_type falls through to phone/email/national_id search — keep that in mind for any future tests.
